title: Bound To The Bed Deepener (F4A)
description: In this file I want to train your focus and attention inward, on your mind, without those pesky distractions of moving or getting up. And I have an easy solution ... I'll just tie you up. Leave you bound to the bed until I decided to release you ... until I am done playing with you. Because I want you to go deeper for me then you ever have before. Because every time you go into trance you go deeper then you did before. There is enough give in my rope that you can shift and stay comfortably deep, but once I've started tying you down, I won't let you move away.
author: Mistress Shibby
